HediffDef.label: test: full mood and food
HediffDef.description: Keeps mood and food full. Select this pawn again with the mood and food rectangle tool to remove. Other needs and existing health conditions remain unchanged.

HediffDef.label: test: skills 20, work speed x10
HediffDef.description: Temporarily reads all skills as 20 and multiplies global work speed by 10. Learning and forgetting are suspended. Select this pawn again with the skilled worker rectangle tool to remove both effects. Disabled work types remain disabled.
